fredonia-natural-gas-well.research_focus: William Hart's shallow gas well at Fredonia, New York, in the 1820s, and early hollowed-log and lead gas piping
fredonia-natural-gas-well.scene: A gunsmith kneels beside a shallow hand-dug pit by a creek, fitting a hollowed log pipe that runs toward a small-town storefront where a single gas flame burns

baku-first-mechanical-oil-well.research_focus: the Bibi-Heybat oil well near Baku in the 1840s, early percussion drilling rigs, and the Absheron shoreline of the Caspian
baku-first-mechanical-oil-well.scene: A timber percussion rig on a bare, oil-stained shoreline by the Caspian Sea, workers in Russian imperial-era dress hauling on the rope that lifts the iron bit

drake-well-titusville.research_focus: the Drake Well at Titusville, Pennsylvania, in 1859: its wooden derrick and engine house, Oil Creek, and the barrels of the first oil
drake-well-titusville.scene: A plain wooden derrick and engine house in a wooded creek valley, a bearded man in a top hat watching oil pour from a pipe into a wooden barrel

first-oil-pipeline-pithole.research_focus: Samuel Van Syckel's 1865 iron pipeline from Pithole, Pennsylvania, to the Miller Farm railhead, and the teamsters who hauled oil barrels by wagon
first-oil-pipeline-pithole.scene: A line of screwed iron pipe running over muddy hills toward a railway siding of wooden tank cars, an idle horse-drawn wagon of barrels left beside it

gluckauf-first-modern-tanker.research_focus: the steam tanker Glückauf of 1886, built on the Tyne for a German oil importer, with oil carried directly against the hull plates
gluckauf-first-modern-tanker.scene: A long iron steamship with a single funnel set well aft sits at a quay, a hose running from shore tanks straight into hatches along its deck; no barrels aboard

spindletop-gusher.research_focus: the Lucas gusher at Spindletop near Beaumont, Texas, in January 1901, its wooden derrick and the crowds that gathered
spindletop-gusher.scene: A towering column of oil bursts from the top of a wooden derrick on flat coastal prairie, men in hats running back as it rains down over them

persia-oil-discovery-masjed-soleiman.research_focus: the 1908 oil strike at Masjed Soleyman in the Zagros foothills of southwest Persia, its cable-tool rig and the D'Arcy concession drillers
persia-oil-discovery-masjed-soleiman.scene: A lone wooden cable-tool rig in rugged, dry Zagros foothills, a turbaned local worker and a British driller in a pith helmet watching oil surge from the well

standard-oil-breakup.research_focus: the 1911 Supreme Court decision dissolving Standard Oil, Progressive Era trust-busting, and the famous octopus cartoons of Standard Oil
standard-oil-breakup.scene: Robed justices in a marble chamber of 1911, and before them on a table a carved model of an oil refinery split cleanly into many separate pieces

teapot-dome-oil-leases.research_focus: the Teapot Dome naval oil reserve in Wyoming, the teapot-shaped rock formation that named it, and the secret leases of the early 1920s
teapot-dome-oil-leases.scene: A teapot-shaped sandstone butte rising over Wyoming scrubland, an oil derrick beside it, and in the foreground two men in 1920s suits passing a bag between them

baba-gurgur-gusher-iraq.research_focus: the Baba Gurgur well near Kirkuk in October 1927 and the eternal fire of Baba Gurgur, with the Turkish Petroleum Company's rig
baba-gurgur-gusher-iraq.scene: A great fountain of oil erupting over a wooden derrick on the dry plain near Kirkuk, villagers and drillers fleeing on foot, low gas flames flickering in the ground nearby

east-texas-oil-field-discovery.research_focus: Dad Joiner's Daisy Bradford No. 3 well in Rusk County, East Texas, in 1930, Depression-era farms and the boom of derricks that followed
east-texas-oil-field-discovery.scene: A rickety patched-together wooden derrick in a pine-edged Depression-era farm field, a crowd of farmers in overalls cheering as oil spurts from it

bahrain-first-gulf-oil-strike.research_focus: the Bahrain Petroleum Company's first well at Jebel Dukhan in 1932, Bahrain's desert interior, and Gulf dress of the period
bahrain-first-gulf-oil-strike.scene: A steel drilling rig beside a low rocky hill in flat desert on a small island, Bahraini workers in robes and headcloths and an American driller gathered at its base

first-offshore-well-out-of-sight-of-land.research_focus: the Kerr-McGee Ship Shoal Block 32 well in the Gulf of Mexico in 1947, its small platform and the converted navy tender beside it
first-offshore-well-out-of-sight-of-land.scene: A small steel drilling platform alone on open sea with no land on any horizon, a converted wartime landing ship moored beside it as a supply tender

iran-nationalizes-oil-industry.research_focus: the 1951 nationalization of the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company, the Abadan refinery, and crowds in Tehran in 1951
iran-nationalizes-oil-industry.scene: A vast refinery of towers and storage tanks at Abadan by a river, a crowd of Iranian men in 1951 dress gathered at its gates as British staff walk out carrying suitcases

groningen-gas-field-discovery.research_focus: the 1959 Slochteren gas discovery in Groningen, the Netherlands, its drilling rig and the flat polder farmland around it
groningen-gas-field-discovery.scene: A slender drilling rig rising over flat Dutch farmland with a windmill and canal in the distance, a tall gas flare burning from a pipe beside it

trans-alaska-pipeline-first-oil.research_focus: the Trans-Alaska Pipeline in 1977, its zigzag elevated sections on vertical supports, the tundra and the Brooks Range
trans-alaska-pipeline-first-oil.scene: A great steel pipeline zigzags across tundra on raised supports toward snow-capped mountains, a caribou herd passing beneath it

iranian-revolution-oil-shock.research_focus: the 1979 oil crisis, long petrol queues at American filling stations, and the cars and pumps of 1979
iranian-revolution-oil-shock.scene: A long queue of 1970s sedans stretches down a street to a small filling station, drivers leaning on their car roofs waiting, the pump hose hung up and the forecourt empty; no signs and no leaders

oil-price-collapse-glut.research_focus: the 1986 oil glut and price collapse, idle drilling rigs in Texas and Oklahoma in 1986, and tankers waiting full offshore
oil-price-collapse-glut.scene: Rows of idle, rusting drilling rigs stacked in a yard under a wide sky, and beyond them a crowded anchorage of full oil tankers with nowhere to unload

kuwait-oil-fires.research_focus: the Kuwaiti oil fires of 1991, burning wellheads in the desert, firefighting crews, and the darkened sky over Kuwait
kuwait-oil-fires.scene: Dozens of oil wells burn as towering fountains of flame across a flat desert, thick smoke turning the sky to dusk at midday, a lone firefighting crew's truck in silhouette

exxon-mobil-merger.research_focus: the 1998 Exxon and Mobil merger, their shared origin in the Standard Oil trust, and 1990s oil company filling stations and refineries
exxon-mobil-merger.scene: Two great oil refineries on opposite riverbanks joined by a newly built steel pipeline bridge across the water, an empty boardroom table with two pens lying side by side in the foreground; no people

record-crude-oil-price-peak.research_focus: the July 2008 record oil price, a 2008 commodities trading floor, and filling stations of 2008
record-crude-oil-price-peak.scene: A crowded commodities trading pit of 2008, traders in trading jackets shouting with raised hands under a towering wall of glowing price screens shown only as blurred light

saudi-aramco-ipo.research_focus: the December 2019 Saudi Aramco listing on the Tadawul exchange in Riyadh, Aramco's Ras Tanura facilities, and Riyadh's skyline
saudi-aramco-ipo.scene: A ceremonial brass bell on a stage in a modern stock exchange hall in Riyadh, and through the tall windows the Riyadh skyline; no people at the podium

oil-price-negative-wti.research_focus: the April 2020 collapse of WTI oil futures, the Cushing, Oklahoma storage hub with its tank farms, and empty pandemic-era highways
oil-price-negative-wti.scene: A vast tank farm of round flat-roofed steel storage tanks filled to capacity on the Oklahoma plain, an empty interstate highway running past it during lockdown
